span.p:
DELETE /api/audio/{audioCode}
DELETE /api/project/{projectCode}

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(92, 32, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
403 ACCESS_DENIED
404 AUDIO_NOT_FOUND / PROJECT_NOT_FOUND

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
removed_at = Instant.now, removed_by = actor,
repository.save — the row stays in its own table

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Project only, and only AFTER the project row is saved:
snapshot findAllByProject per media type, then softTrashByProject —
UPDATE ... SET removed_at, removed_by, version + 1
WHERE project = :project AND removed_at IS NULL
person and categories are deliberately untouched

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
readCache.evictAll on each cache whose count changed, then one
DELETE audit row per record via the REQUIRES_NEW audit services

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
204 No Content — deleteStoredFile is never reached on this path,
so the S3 object and audio_file_url survive for a later restore

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GET /api/audio/trash · GET /api/project/trash
requireAdminRole, findAllByRemovedAtIsNotNull, mapped to DTOs,
paged in memory by PaginationSupport.sliceList, audited as LIST

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST /{code}/restore — requireAdminRole,
then findByAudioCode / findByProjectCode
ignores removed_at, so an unknown code is a 404

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: removed_at IS NULL?

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
audio: is the parent project itself still trashed?
project: existsByProjectCodeAndRemovedAtIsNull?

div.style: color: rgb(92, 32, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
400 AUDIO_VALIDATION_ERROR / PROJECT_VALIDATION_ERROR
'Audio is not in trash' · 'Project is not in trash' ·
'Cannot restore audio while its project is in trash'
409 PROJECT_ALREADY_EXISTS — an active project already holds this code

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DELETE /{code}/purge — requireAdminRole,
then findByAudioCode / findByProjectCode (404 on unknown code)

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: removed_at IS NULL?

div.style: color: rgb(92, 32, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
400 AUDIO_VALIDATION_ERROR / PROJECT_VALIDATION_ERROR
'... must be in trash before permanent deletion. Trash it first.'

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
audio: PURGE audit row, delete row, evictAll, then deleteStoredFile
project: deleteStoredFile for every media URL FIRST (text contributes
text_file_url and cover_image_url), then per-row PURGE audits,
deleteAll media rows, project PURGE audit, delete project row, evictAll

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
deleteStoredFile: url non-null, non-blank
AND s3Service.isOurS3Url(url)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
deleteByUrl extracts the key via extractKeyFromUrl,
then deleteByKey calls s3Client.deleteObject on the bucket

div.style: color: rgb(92, 32, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S3Exception is caught inside deleteByKey: logged as
'S3 delete failed for key=...' and returns false. deleteFile discards
that boolean and the DB row is already gone, so the object is
orphaned in the bucket and nothing ever retries it

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
204 No Content — identical response whether S3 succeeded,
was skipped, or threw
